The amendment revises the statutory definitions, reservation and sub-categorisation provisions, certificate requirements and schedules, and omits section 16. Percentage-setting and sub-categorisation require consultation with the Commission. Published on 15 July; brought into force on 27 July 2026 by BCW/15011/17/1579. The amendment does not itself publish a new class list or restore 17% reservation.

The amendment revises member-secretary eligibility and tenure, and substitutes section 9 on inclusion requests, over-/under-inclusion complaints and ordinarily binding Commission advice. Published on 15 July; brought into force on 27 July 2026 by BCW/15011/18/1580. Read with the principal 1993 Act rather than treating the original text as the complete current statute.

The Gazette notification appoints 27 July 2026 as the commencement date of the amendment to the 2012 reservation Act. Publication of the Act on 15 July and its commencement on 27 July are separate events.
The Gazette notification appoints 27 July 2026 as the commencement date of the amendment to the 1993 Commission Act.

BCW Department notification to all recruiting agencies on OBC reservation in recruitments already under way. Where appointment letters were already issued on a final merit list, the reservation policy in force at the time applies (10% OBC-A and 7% OBC-B, for processes begun before 22 May 2024 or between 10 June 2025 and 18 May 2026). All other cases follow Notifications 944 and 945 of 18 May 2026, read with the Labour Department roster notification Labr/85-Emp/EC/1M-01/2025 of 25 May 2026.

West Bengal Board of Primary Education notice for the 2025 Assistant Teacher recruitment (Memo 2141 of 25 September 2025). A portal open from 14 to 31 October 2026 lets OBC-A and OBC-B applicants name their class if it is in the 66-class list of Notification 945, or move to Unreserved if it is not. Applicants who do nothing are treated as Unreserved, and an original OBC certificate is needed at verification.

West Bengal Board of Primary Education notice continuing Memo 3536. Because vacancies were revised after Notifications 944 and 945, a portal open from 5 to 9 November 2026 lets candidates with disabilities update their category, and also lets candidates who have not declared OBC status do so to claim OBC reservation. It comes after the High Court's 30 October 2026 order that the October window did not allow fresh applications.

Labour Department Gazette notification (Kolkata Gazette Extraordinary, 25 May 2026) prescribing the revised Model 100-Point Roster of Vacancies after Notification 945-BCW. OBC now has 7 of the 100 points (points 9, 19, 29, 49, 59, 69 and 89; points 19 and 69 are for exempted-category OBC candidates and point 49 for an OBC ex-serviceman in Group-D posts), matching the 7% reservation. It also sets the EWS, SC, ST, disability, ex-serviceman and sportsperson points, and supersedes Labour Department Notification Labr/20-EMP/EC/1M-01/2025 of 27 January 2026.

West Bengal Commission for Backward Classes letter to all District Magistrates and the KMC Commissioner. Citing the High Court order of 6 May 2025 in WPA(P) 111/2025, it records that seven communities not on any list had applied for OBC inclusion (Mahishya, Baishya Saha, Kayastha, Samudra Banik, Deswali Majhi, Beniya (Gandha Banik) and Ekadash Tili) and asks for a benchmark survey of them from 28 May to 6 June 2025, with BAE&S and CRI to report to the Commission by 9 June 2025.

Compiled file. The Commission sends the BCW Secretary its reports on 25 classes, recommended for inclusion under section 9(1) of the 1993 Act and approved at its 466th meeting on 28 May 2025, with the meeting's decisions. It also holds the Department's letter of 17 April 2025 asking the Commission to consult on sub-classifying the 66 classes and those under survey, and the 2024-25 file notes in which the Law Department questioned treating the struck-down classes as EWS while the State's appeal was pending.

Block Development Officer, Purbasthali-II (Purba Bardhaman), to all Gram Panchayats: SC, ST and OBC certificate holders whose certificates are to be verified must attend hearings at the BDO office, 100 holders a day, on set dates from 11 June to 9 July 2026. The schedule lists about 30,000 certificate holders across ten panchayats. It shows how the 14 May 2026 re-verification memo was carried out on the ground before the High Court stayed it on 18 August 2026.

West Bengal College Service Commission notice for Assistant Professor recruitment (Advertisement 1/2026): a 7-day edit window from 25 June to 1 July 2026. Candidates who applied as OBC-A or OBC-B must update their category under Notification 945-BCW/MR-23/2026 of 18 May 2026, or risk rejection. This is the notice challenged in WPA 14695 and 14698 of 2026.

Kolkata Gazette Extraordinary publishing the Bill to amend the West Bengal Backward Classes (Reservation of Vacancies in Services and Posts) Act, 2012. It renames the Act, defines OBCs by the 1993 Commission Act, lets the State fix the OBC percentage and any sub-categories only in consultation with the Commission (total SC, ST and OBC reservation not above 50%), and omits section 16 and Schedules I and III. These are the provisions the 2024 judgment struck down. The Bill became West Bengal Act VIII of 2026 (Notification 658-L of 15 July 2026), in force from 27 July 2026.

BCW Secretary to eleven recruiting bodies (College, Municipal, Central School, Madrasah and Co-operative Service Commissions, PSC, Health and Police Recruitment Boards, WBJEEB, Medical Education and the Primary Board): report within 7 days every ongoing recruitment, its stage and which reservation policy and 100-point roster it follows, split into processes begun before 22 May 2024, between 10 June 2025 and 18 May 2026, and after 18 May 2026. This review led to Notification 1060 of 7 August 2026.

West Bengal Central School Service Commission notice: document verification for successful 2nd SLST (AT) 2025 candidates for Classes IX-X in English, Physical Science and Life Science starts on 30 July 2026 at the Regional Commissions. Context for the SLST category cases (WPA 23207/2026 and FMA 1002/2026).

Following BCW Memo 1060 of 7 August 2026, the School Service Commission opened its portal from 20 to 25 August 2026 for 2nd SLST (AT) 2025 Classes XI-XII candidates to update their OBC sub-category or Unreserved details with certificate number and issuing authority. Anyone who did not do so would be treated as Unreserved (General), with no extension.

BCW Department (Additional Secretary, Law) to all District Magistrates, with a copy of the High Court's interim order of 18 August 2026 in WPA(P) 275 and 300 of 2026: the 14 May 2026 memo on re-verifying all caste certificates issued since 2011 is stayed until the PILs are decided, but Sub-Divisional Officers may still act under the 1994 Act and 1995 Rules. DMs are asked to instruct SDOs accordingly.
